slides.texte_overlay:
the museum rules elegant
girls quietly follow

1. go on a weekday morning

the rooms are almost empty.

2. leave your big bag
at the cloakroom

3. learn one story before you go

it changes how you see
the whole room.
slides.texte_sophia:
3. learn one story before you go

i read the story of one painting
on an app like Sophia.

slides.texte_overlay:
4. don't block the view
for a photo

one photo, then put it away.

5. sit on a bench in front
of one work

ten minutes, nothing else.

6. end at the museum café

and talk about your
favourite piece.

save this for your
next museum day
